description: Facebook Page follower counts from Facebook's public Page Plugin: for up to 10 Pages (username, numeric ID or facebook.com URL) the Page name, numeric page ID, verified badge, profile picture URL and exact follower count, sorted by followers. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
